Secrets Management

 

Welcome to the Akeyless Secrets Management product video. In this short module, you’ll learn about the challenges enterprises face that drive the need for secrets management, the Akeyless capabilities that solve those challenges, key customer use cases, and what makes Akeyless stand out from the competition. We’ll wrap up with a quick look at our platform differentiators and a real customer success story. Let’s get started. Why do enterprises need secrets management? Enterprises today face a growing sprawl of unprotected secrets, API keys, tokens, and certificates scattered across cloud, DevOps, and automation environments. This uncontrolled spread increases exposure risk and makes it nearly impossible to maintain visibility. Teams also struggle with the hassle of manually rotating secrets, which is time consuming, error prone, and often neglected. Static credentials stay active for months, creating one of the most common breach vectors in modern infrastructures. Unsecured secrets sharing compounds the problem. Developers frequently pass credentials through chat tools, spreadsheets, or scripts without proper access policies or audit trails, leaving organizations vulnerable to leaks. Traditional solutions add to the pain. The high cost and complexity of vault clusters create operational overhead and scalability issues, forcing teams to maintain infrastructure instead of securing it. Finally, many organizations lack governance and control, with no unified visibility across environments or consistent enforcement of rotation and access policies. Akeyless was designed to solve all these challenges with a true SaaS model, zero knowledge encryption, and centralized secrets lifecycle management that’s simple to adopt and effortless to scale. Akeyless addresses every key enterprise challenge through a powerful, unified platform. We start with centralized, encrypted secret storage secured by zero knowledge architecture and granular RBAC and ABAC access control, ensuring that only authorized users, workloads, or systems can access what they need and nothing more. Automated rotation and life cycle management remove the manual burden of renewing or retiring secrets, drastically reducing the risk of credential exposure. With dynamic, just in time credential issuance, Iqalus provides short lived, on demand secrets, eliminating standing privileges and supporting true zero trust operations. Secure secret sharing makes collaboration across teams and environments safe, auditable, and policy driven. Aculus integrates natively with over one hundred tools via plugins, SDKs, and APIs, embedding security directly into existing DevOps and CICD workflows. Through PKI TLS certificate issuance and secretless access based on SPIFFE, OIDC, and UID standards, Aculus enables passwordless authentication for humans, machines, and AI agents. We also offer automated secrets migration, comprehensive audit logging and monitoring, and secrets discovery, now in alpha, to identify unmanaged or exposed credentials across your environments. Together, these capabilities make Akeyless a complete, future ready solution for enterprise scale secrets management. Akeyless delivers value across a wide range of real world use cases. Starting with insider risk reduction. Akeyless replaces standing credentials with short lived, just in time secrets, dramatically minimizing the risk of insider misuse or accidental exposure. For DevOps pipeline security, the platform injects and automatically rotates secrets across CICD and automation tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Terra form, securing every stage of the development lifecycle. In cloud native workload protection, Aculus securely delivers secrets to containers, functions, and microservices, ensuring workloads authenticate safely without ever storing credentials and Secure SSH and machine access is simplified through short lived, certificate based credentials, replacing shared keys and manual provisioning. Akeyless also supports regulatory compliance by automating rotation, audit trails, and reporting to meet PCI DSS, HIPAA and SOC two standards. For cross team collaboration, secrets can be shared safely through role based access controls, with full visibility and auditability. Cloud and platform migration becomes seamless, allowing teams to migrate and consolidate secrets with zero downtime. Finally, Akeyless prevents secrets sprawl by centralizing management, dynamically injecting credentials, and tracking them across all environments. Why we do it better? Akeyless delivers a modern approach to secrets and key management through our zero knowledge SaaS architecture, with patented DFC, ensuring that sensitive data is always encrypted end to end, and never visible to anyone but the customer. With our unified secrets, keys, certificates, and access organizations can consolidate multiple tools into one secure, efficient solution, reducing silos and simplifying operations. We enable dynamic, just in time and secretless security everywhere, eliminating static credentials and automating access both human and machine identities. Our platform is hybrid, multi cloud, and on prem integration ready, seamlessly extending protection and automation across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on prem environments. Through enterprise grade compliance, auditing, and governance automation, Akeyless helps meet the strictest regulatory standards with built in visibility and control. The platform is AI ready and effortless to adopt and scale, aligning with evolving enterprise architectures and future workloads. With SaaS simplicity, no infrastructure or maintenance needed, customers deploy quickly and eliminate operational overhead. Ultimately, Akeyless delivers up to seventy percent lower TCO and faster value, transforming security from a burden into a business enabler. Simpris customer evidence. The problem. Simpris, a two billion dollars global organization, struggled with their previous secrets management provider. They faced high TCO, usability issues, and a solution that simply wasn’t reliable enough to support their distributed teams. Managing infrastructure, monitoring uptime, and providing twenty four seven support added unnecessary complexity and cost. The solution. Simpris chose Akeyless for its easy onboarding, high level of support, and true SaaS simplicity, delivering secure secrets management with zero maintenance. Within months, adoption rates increased by two hundred and seventy percent, while total cost of ownership dropped by seventy percent. Simprus gained more functionality, better user experience, and higher confidence in operational reliability. Today, Simprus teams no longer worry about secret rotation or credential leakage. Everything just works. Akeyless provided the modern, scalable platform they needed to secure global operations efficiently and at lower cost. Thank you for watching this video.

Secrets sprawl and static credentials increase risk across modern enterprises. In this video, discover how Akeyless Secrets Management eliminates standing secrets with dynamic, just-in-time access and Zero-Knowledge security, centralizing control, automating rotation, and securing cloud-native and DevOps environments without operational overhead.
